title: Sensor restarts never work - Pixel 4 XL Transmitter 8H
body:
I have been struggling with sensor restarts on my pixel 4 xl.  I usually am able to use my ticwatch pro to restart the sensor, but now I'm not able to.  This has been going on for a while.  Not sure if anyone else has these issues or what to do to fix it.

![Screenshot_20200315-104901](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28109677/76703794-b4ae0b80-66aa-11ea-87fd-20d75e29cfe4.png)
![Screenshot_20200315-104856~2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28109677/76703802-b8da2900-66aa-11ea-9627-d8acb002ceb0.png)

comments.body:
This has been an issue for 81 - 8H transmitters. It was reported first in January in #1199 but there has been no movement on it. It looks like jamorham did discover a new hardware/firmware version and had coded it as not being capable of preemptive restarts on Feb 7th. 

still waiting

awesome thank you.  That is my exact issue.  Ugh this sucks
The only thing that works for me for now is removing transmitter from the sensor by unlatching it from the sides, waiting for 15 minutes, putting back in, and starting the sensor again.

I can never do that I always break the sensor

> I use iFixit [spudger](https://www.ifixit.com/Store/Tools/Metal-Spudger/IF145-012?o=5). Works everytime.

I just tried it.  I think I got it.  Lol thanks!  This sucks

I routinely use 2 old glucose test strips.  Insert one alongside the transmitter near the fatter part and you can feel a click as it releases.  Then slide another one in at the same place on the other side and out it pops.  Simple.

@ThoR294 Would you please close this issue if you are satisfied with the validity of the answers?
